name: Morphing Text
description: Words melt into each other: two layers cross-blur while an SVG threshold filter fuses their edges into liquid letterforms.
a11y: All words exposed once via aria-label; visual layers are aria-hidden. Reduced motion: words swap instantly.
perf: One rAF loop updating two filters; pauses with the tab (rAF).
prompt: Create liquid morphing text: two stacked spans (current/next word) whose opacity and blur cross-fade over `morphTime` (blur = 8/f − 8 px, opacity = f^0.4), wrapped in an SVG `feColorMatrix` alpha-threshold filter (`0 0 0 255 -140`) so the blurred overlap fuses into gooey letters. Hold each word `holdTime`. rAF loop; reduced motion swaps words with no morph.

name: Circular Text Badge
description: Text set on a circle with an SVG textPath slowly spins around a center icon; the center pops on hover.
a11y: Wrapper has aria-label with the text; the spinning SVG is aria-hidden. Reduced motion: static ring.
props: Text around the circle (end with a separator).
prompt: Build a circular text badge: an SVG circle path (`M50,50 m-38,0 a38,38 0 1,1 76,0 a38,38 0 1,1 -76,0`) with uppercase tracked text on a `<textPath>` (textLength fitted), the SVG rotating 360° linearly forever with Motion; a center slot for an icon that scales 1.1 and rotates −12° with a back-out ease on hover.

name: 3D Flip Words
description: The next word's letters flip down into place in 3D, staggered left-to-right, while the old word blurs away.
a11y: sr-only list of all words; animated letters aria-hidden. Reduced motion: fade.
perf: Per-letter transforms, one word mounted at a time.
prompt: Create flip words: AnimatePresence popLayout keyed by word; each letter is an inline-block with `transform-origin: top` animating rotateX −100°→0, y −6→0, opacity 0→1 with a spring (300/22) staggered 40ms; exit the old word with y −16 and blur 6px. Parent has perspective 600px.

name: Scroll Velocity Marquee
description: Giant looping text lines that speed up, reverse direction and skew with your scroll velocity.
a11y: aria-label holds the text once; repeated copies are aria-hidden. Reduced motion: static line.
props: Base speed (% per second, negative reverses).
prompt: Build a scroll-velocity marquee with Motion: `useScroll` → `useVelocity` → `useSpring(damping 50, stiffness 400)` → factor via useTransform [0,1000]→[0,5]. In `useAnimationFrame` advance a base value by baseVelocity·dt, flip direction with the velocity sign and multiply by the factor; x = wrap(−25%, −50%, base) over 4 repeated copies. Skew X ±12° from velocity.

name: Wave Letters
description: Letters ripple upward one after another like a stadium wave — on hover/focus or continuously.
a11y: aria-label with the full word; hover variant also triggers on keyboard focus. Reduced motion: still.
perf: Per-letter transform keyframes; remount-by-key to replay.
prompt: Create wave text: split into inline-block letters; on pointerenter/focus increment a key so each letter replays `y: [0, −height, 0]` (500ms back-out) delayed 35ms × index; loop mode repeats with a 1.2s pause.

name: Glitch Text
description: Cyan/red channel-split glitch bursts with sliced clip-paths, pure CSS, spaced out to stay epilepsy-safe.
a11y: Bursts occupy ~10% of a ≥2s cycle — well under WCAG 2.3.1's 3 flashes/s. Pseudo layers hidden under reduced motion.
perf: Two pseudo-elements, stepped keyframes; 0 KB JS.
prompt: Create a CSS glitch: `::before`/`::after` duplicate the text via `content: attr(data-text)`, colored cyan and red, idle with `clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0)`; in the last 12% of a cycle (steps(1)) jump through 3 random slices with ±3px translations. Faster on hover. Hidden under reduced motion.

name: Letter Roll Hover
description: Every letter rolls up to reveal a duplicate of itself, staggered from start, center or end — the agency nav link hover.
a11y: aria-label keeps the word; works on :focus-visible and when the parent link/button is hovered.
prompt: Build a CSS letter-roll hover: each letter is a 2-row inline-flex column (letter + duplicate) inside an overflow-hidden line; on hover/focus-visible (or parent a/button hover) translate each column −50% with `cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)` 450ms, delayed by a per-letter CSS var computed from start/center/end distance.

name: Split-Flap Board
description: Airport departure board: every cell flaps through the character set until it lands on its target text.
a11y: Exposes the final value via aria-label; cells aria-hidden. Reduced motion: shows the value immediately.
perf: One interval per board; text-only updates.
prompt: Create a split-flap display: each character is a dark rounded cell with a horizontal seam line; an interval advances every unsettled cell to the next char in ` ABC…Z0-9:-.` until it equals its target, then stops. Monospace amber text.

name: Sparkle Text
description: Four-point stars twinkle in and out around a word — for 'magic' moments, upgrades and AI features.
a11y: Sparkles are aria-hidden SVGs; none rendered under reduced motion.
prompt: Create sparkle text: keep a rolling array of N sparkles (random x/y %, size 8–20px, color); every 420ms drop the oldest and add one. Each is an SVG four-point star that scales 0→1 rotating 0→90°, then exits scaling to 0 rotating to 180° (AnimatePresence).

name: Variable Weight Proximity
description: Letters thicken through a variable font's weight axis and lift slightly as the cursor approaches them.
a11y: Text stays real (aria-label); effect off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: One rAF loop reading rects of letters; keep to headlines.
prompt: Build cursor-proximity variable-font text: track the pointer; in a rAF loop, for each letter compute distance to its center, t = max(0, 1 − d/radius), set `font-variation-settings: "wght" min + (max−min)·t²` and translate −4t px. Requires a variable font (e.g. Geist, Inter var).

name: Falling Letters
description: Click the headline and its letters drop with gravity, bounce off the floor and tumble; click again to spring them back.
a11y: It's a real button with a descriptive label; reduced motion just toggles positions.
perf: Tiny custom integrator; stops when settled.
prompt: Create falling text with a tiny physics loop: on click give each letter random vy (−200…−500), vx (±130) and spin; integrate gravity each frame, bounce at the container floor with 0.38 restitution and friction, write translate/rotate; stop when settled. A second click springs all letters back.

name: Line Loop
description: Cycles whole lines or nodes vertically through a masked slot — status messages, rotating taglines, mini tickers.
a11y: aria-live=polite so updates are announced; reduced motion crossfades.
perf: One item mounted at a time plus the exiting one.
prompt: Build a vertical text loop: an overflow-hidden slot with AnimatePresence popLayout keyed by index; items enter from y ±100% and exit to ∓100% with a spring (260/30), cycling on an interval. aria-live polite.

name: Stroke Draw Text
description: The outline of a word draws itself on view, then the fill floods in — a signature/logo reveal.
a11y: SVG has role=img and aria-label; reduced motion renders filled text.
perf: stroke-dashoffset + fill-opacity on one SVG text.
prompt: Create stroke-draw text: SVG <text> with stroke = fill = currentColor, strokeDasharray 600 → strokeDashoffset 600→0 over `duration` (ease-in-out) when in view, then fill-opacity 0→1 starting at 75% of the draw.

name: Odometer Number
description: Each digit is a vertical reel that springs to its new number — the slot-machine counter for live stats and prices.
a11y: aria-label holds the formatted value; reels aria-hidden. Reduced motion: instant.
perf: One transform per digit; keyed by place value so unchanged digits don't move.
prompt: Build an odometer: format the value with Intl.NumberFormat; render separators as text and each digit as a 1em-tall overflow-hidden window containing a 0–9 column translated to −d×10% with a spring (180/22). Key digits by place from the right so only changed reels move.
